conclusion: Preliminary result at seed 7 on clean labels (outlier_fraction 0.0): OLS achieves lower MSE (0.17046895861013783) than the matched training-mean baseline (12.888358499556563). This is a single-seed, single-metric preliminary observation only; the full budget (seeds 7,19,31; mse,mae,median_absolute_error) has not been run, so no general claim is made.
limitations: Only seed 7 was executed; seeds 19 and 31 were not run.
Only mse was computed; mae and median_absolute_error were not computed.
Single seed and single metric preclude any general or scientific conclusion.
No statistical testing or uncertainty quantification was performed.
Results are specific to this task configuration (clean labels, outlier_fraction 0.0) and do not extend to other settings.
